fingerprint.fps: variable, 30 nominal; 12978 video frames in 662.50 s

interventions.what: Bandicam window capture of the Isle Wars Pro game window; the owner played one game from the options screen to the end screen (11:02 recording). The video file is the only output. No scripted clicks. Counters, seats and screens were read from pixels by region comparison and template matching of glyph shapes, with no OCR pass.

start_state.restore: Owner launched a new game on the unregistered Pro build from the options screen (seat 1 human, three computer seats, middle strength). Pro has no save file (C-SET-05), so no state was restored. The recording starts on the title screen; the opening deal is the first board.

args: probe: 662.50 s, 12978 video frames, variable frame rate (nominal 30), 1920x1080 H.264, AAC 48 kHz stereo, 87585120 bytes
ffmpeg 8.0.1; the panel regions were read frame by frame from the container timestamps; offsets are mm:ss.mmm video offsets
record content: the options screen, the opening deal, the 12 human placements, the computer moves, the elimination of the human seat and the end of the game

observations.field: options screen at video offset 00:01.0 to 00:03.0
observations.value: five option groups (starting armies with five entries, seat toggles for four seats, a strength group with three entries, an event-frequency group with four entries, a speed group with three entries) plus a sound icon, a save-as-default button and a play button; the seat row shows one human then three computers; highlighted entries: the second starting-armies entry, the middle strength, the middle event frequency and the middle speed. The recording starts on the title screen (00:00.0); this screen is up at 00:01.0 and 00:02.0, the title screen is back at 00:03.0 (the owner pressed play between 00:02.0 and 00:03.0) and the empty board is up at 00:04.0. Same screen and defaults as in IP1 026.

observations.field: human placement summary
observations.value: 12 placements in 12 human turns; the owner placed the whole pool each time, in one go except turn 1 (2 on one country, then 1 on another); every placement went to a country already holding 1 to 3 armies; stack sizes after placement 5 and 4 (turn 1), then 5, 6, 5, 4, 5, 5, 4, 3, 4, 4; the counter never exceeded the pool; the placement is committed with the place button (the counter returns to 0 and the pool message counts down, 1 army left after the first placement of turn 1); the biggest human stack of the sitting is 6 (country 42, from 3 plus 3 at placement 4). The owner never built the stacks of 8, 12 or 20 for which the sitting was meant.
